mapper.select: SELECT n.* FROM notice n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND n.publish_at <= NOW() AND (n.expire_at IS NULL OR n.expire_at > NOW()) AND (n.target_role = #{role} OR n.target_role = 'ALL') ORDER BY n.publish_at DESC, n.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notice n WHERE n.deleted = 0 AND n.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND n.publish_at <= NOW() AND (n.expire_at IS NULL OR n.expire_at > NOW()) AND (n.target_role = #{role} OR n.target_role = 'ALL') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notice_read r WHERE r.notice_id = n.id AND r.user_id = #{userId})
